description:
Store and inspect tokens without exposing them (AES-256-GCM at rest). action: set | get (metadata only) | list | delete. Inject into commands with project_shell_run secret_env=[NAME]; the GitHub tools read GITHUB_TOKEN on their own.
Use when: you save a non-GitHub token, check expiry or rotation, or remove one. Prefer value_env over value so the secret never appears in chat.
Avoid when: the value is plain config (use .env or the config file). reveal=1 prints plaintext and needs VENIRA_SECRET_ALLOW_REVEAL=1.
Output: set: name, length, expires_at, days_left. get and list: metadata only.

action.description: set stores a secret; get returns metadata only (plaintext needs reveal=1); list shows all stored secrets; delete removes one.

expires_at.description: action=set: absolute expiry (epoch ms or ISO-8601), instead of expires_in_days.

expires_in_days.description: action=set: expiry in days (e.g. 90 for quarterly rotation). Expired secrets are not injected.

name.description: Env-var style name, e.g. GITHUB_TOKEN (required for get/set/delete).

reason.description: Optional why (max 400 chars), audit-logged. Required only on project_ci_control.

reveal.description: action=get: 1 returns the plaintext value and requires VENIRA_SECRET_ALLOW_REVEAL=1 on the host; prefer secret_env injection.

value.description: Secret value for action=set. Prefer value_env so it never appears in the transcript.

value_env.description: Read the value from this host environment variable instead of `value` (never logged).
